templates.title: an instant is one simultaneous moment

then: all events belong to one instant and follow one lifecycle
a constructed turn boundary is handled as an instant like any other. Where no turn boundary exists, this test checks nothing about turn boundaries.

templates.text: An instant is one moment the game treats as simultaneous. A turn boundary the adoption can construct is an instant like any other. Where there is no turn boundary, this test checks nothing about turn boundaries.

templates.title: waiting and active events are distinguishable

then: before selection it is recorded as a waiting event that has not begun
during ordered effect application it is recorded as the active event
the active event visits an effect boundary before its first effect

templates.text: A waiting event is accepted but has not begun. An active event is applying ordered effects. Every active event visits an effect boundary before its first effect.

templates.title: ending events record no outcome while resolving

where no ending event exists, this test checks nothing

templates.text: Each ending event the adoption can construct follows the ordinary event lifecycle but records no outcome when it resolves. Only step 15 records an outcome, after the waiting set is empty. Where no ending event exists, this test checks nothing.

templates.title: container order never decides event resolution

no event order is taken from container order or document order

templates.text: Changing container order or document order without changing declarations never changes event resolution. Rank, a rank tie, and within-class order decide the sequence; document order never does. Step 5 says container order in the adoption file never selects an event.

templates.title: an accepted proposal commits once and creates one event

where the adoption can construct later source loss, the source becomes unavailable before a captured value is used

one event payload is created once and enters its declared event class at its due instant
the payload contains every value that must stay available after a later loss of the source, while uncaptured state is read only when an effect resolves
where later source loss cannot be constructed, this test checks nothing about the values that must stay available after source loss

templates.text: An accepted proposal creates one payload once and enters its declared event class at its due instant. Where it has an ordinary cost, that cost commits once at the point its rule names. Otherwise this test checks nothing about the cost. templates.title: a new event uses the interrupt path or caused-event path

every other new event due now follows caused-events

templates.text: After an instant opens, a valid declared interrupt enters only through the interrupt path. Every other newly created event due now follows caused-events. For a branch that the adoption cannot construct, this test checks nothing. No event uses both paths.

templates.title: the lowest eligible rank resolves first

selection does not change the selected event's payload
where no instant has two eligible ranks, this test checks nothing about the order of ranks

templates.text: At every selection, the lowest eligible rank resolves first without changing the selected event's payload. templates.text: An event of {{row.id}} at rank {{row.rank}} never resolves before an eligible lower-rank event in the same instant. Where the adoption cannot construct that pairing, this test checks nothing.

the order trace distinguishes selection by stable index from selection by rank or container order

templates.text: Within {{row.class-id}}, lower {{row.index-name}} resolves first. Where the row names a second index, equal first numbers resolve by it; otherwise equal first numbers cannot arise or cannot change the result.

templates.text: Within {{row.class-id}}, earlier admission resolves first, and admission order remains stable for the complete instant.

templates.title: declaration check: terminal-collision rows cover every ending pair

When a pair that can be constructed has no row, the adoption is invalid, and this test fails. Where no win and loss can become true at one instant, this test checks nothing.

templates.title: event resolution holds for the whole run

test.holds: for every instant of the audited run that this adoption alone governs, every event resolved at or after every eligible lower-rank event; every rank tie and within-class selection followed its declared order; every refusal followed its matching case or the default answer; every accepted proposal created one payload once; every valid interrupt entered at its declared point and took effect; every caused event was created once and followed its route; every orphan followed its row; every ending was recorded once at step 15; for an instant shared with another adoption, this test checks nothing; for a case the adoption cannot construct, this test checks nothing

templates.text: Across {{inputs:scope}}, lower eligible ranks never resolve late, each tie and within-class order holds, each proposal follows its case or the default answer, each accepted proposal creates one payload, each valid interrupt takes effect at its entry point, each caused event follows its route, each orphan follows its row, and each ending records once at step 15. For an instant shared with another adoption, this test checks nothing. For a case that the adoption cannot construct, this test checks nothing.

scope.default: every instant of the audited run that this adoption owns in full
